roles.A01: Continuously maintain requirements, experiment ledger, rejected regions and exact reproducibility contracts.
roles.A02: Continuously search and backtest new profit/trade-opportunity candidates for all ten coins and the shared 250-USDC portfolio.
roles.A03: Continuously verify Backtest/Paper/Trial/Live semantic parity and detect state/version drift.
roles.A04: Continuously verify UI/API truthfulness and ensure research candidates never masquerade as promoted product state.
roles.A05: Continuously diagnose idle time, holding duration, slot saturation, loss/winner clusters and runtime opportunity loss.
roles.A06: Continuously regression-test candidate patches, determinism and cross-component behavior; repair known defects.
roles.A07: Continuously validate public Binance USDC market/filter/data assumptions without private credentials or orders.
roles.A08: Continuously challenge strategy, allocator, ranking and risk assumptions under fixed 250-USDC capital.
roles.A09: Independently reject stale, overfit, non-reproducible or technically regressive candidates; only exact-head QA_PASS can advance.
roles.A10: Continuously dispatch the next evidence-led research/repair task, never stopping at a negative experiment.
roles.A11: Continuously audit A01-A10, anti-overfit integrity and promotion evidence; only GOVERNANCE_PASS can authorize engineering promotion.

loop: observe current evidence and event archive
select or create one bounded hypothesis
run ordinary cross-window and shifted full-three-year robustness
materialize validated candidate code on isolated branch
run exact-head A01-A11 against that candidate branch
run sealed future-readiness rejection gate without tuning from its detailed outcomes
promote engineering candidate only after successful A09/A11 validation
accumulate forward shadow evidence on newly arriving closed bars after promotion

D12.name: Hypothesis Architect Dot
D12.objective: Continuously introduce materially new, source-backed, bounded strategy/portfolio hypotheses when the deterministic queue is exhausted or stale.
constraints: no blind parameter churn
one causal family per experiment
record sources and prior rejected regions
no future information

D13.name: Event Intelligence Dot
D13.objective: Build an append-only point-in-time archive of high-impact crypto, regulatory and macro events and research whether event-aware risk throttles add robust value.
constraints: publication timestamp is immutable
source URL required
no retrospective outcome labels
no direct live command without validated replay and paper-forward evidence

D14.name: Engineering Promotion Dot
D14.objective: Turn validated research winners into whitelisted candidate code, run exact-head A01-A11, and promote only engineering state after A09/A11 success.
constraints: candidate must descend from exact protected baseline
whitelisted files only
stable baseline must not change during validation
Paper/Live activation remains manual

D15.name: Universe Discovery Dot
D15.objective: Continuously inspect public Binance USDC spot markets for additional liquid, sufficiently old, diversifying opportunity sources and nominate them for isolated and shared-portfolio research.
constraints: no automatic live symbol addition
minimum history and liquidity required
marginal portfolio contribution required
point-in-time exchange filters only

D16.name: Base Signal Mining Dot
D16.objective: Continuously mine the original high-frequency Hixton flip stream for statistically robust micro-opportunity structures without weakening the core V6 filter.
constraints: never assume all raw flips are tradable
fees/slippage mandatory
micro layer must not cannibalize core signals
separate causal experiment family

D17.name: Future Readiness & Forward Evidence Dot
D17.objective: Try to falsify promoted and candidate behavior under recent sealed proxy windows, harsher execution assumptions and newly arriving post-promotion data without tuning on that evidence.
constraints: future cannot be predicted or claimed to match backtest
recent proxy windows are reject-only and may not select new parameters
new post-promotion data is shadow evidence, not an optimization target
Paper/Live semantic drift must fail closed
Live activation remains separate and non-automatic

D18.name: Protected Baseline Freshness Dot
D18.objective: Before every research cycle verify that all product-critical strategy/config files exactly match the latest protected gpt/usdc-audit engineering head; fail closed on any stale baseline and route a sync repair before further optimization.
constraints: never silently research from an older protected strategy
protected engineering SHA must be recorded in evidence
critical product files must byte-match protected engineering
research-only helpers may differ but may not redefine the current product baseline
a stale-baseline failure blocks downstream claims and candidate promotion

D19.name: Idle Satellite Market Dot
D19.objective: Research a pool of five additional Binance Spot markets that use otherwise idle 250-USDC capacity without weakening or replacing the ten-coin V6 core.
constraints: core V6 entries always have priority over satellite positions
satellites may only consume genuinely free core capacity
satellite positions may be force-exited for a core entry and handoff losses must be modeled
minimum meaningful tranche remains 50 USDC
rank satellites by incremental shared-portfolio profit during core idle windows, not isolated headline profit
regional Binance availability, liquidity and exchange filters must pass before any live inclusion
no automatic live market expansion

current_shared_mission: MISSION-CAPITAL-ACTIVITY-250: reduce idle time and raise meaningful use of the fixed 250 USDC research budget without gaming frequency via tiny orders. Core V6 remains the protected primary strategy; satellites are idle-only and preemptible.
